regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, acknowledgements, and SI statement
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate metathesis claim were inspected. The paper states that Supporting Information is available, but workspace source mapping leaves association unestablished; no SI facts were used. Reproduction acknowledgements for Table 2 entry 4, Table 3 entry 5, and Table 4 entry 1 provide no independent run details and create no duplicate records.

The A–F drawings summarize cited prior allenoate reactivity and the bottom arrow is a generic current transformation. They are classified together as a general scheme, not preparations of A–F or an experiment-specific yield record.

regions.region: page 1 center-right initial observation and Table 1 reaction header, rows 1–12, footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Twelve independent optimization experiments were retained with 0.3 mmol 2a, row-specific aldehyde/base equivalents and amounts, solvents/bases, 50 °C or entry-12 10 °C, 1.5 h, NMR yields, entry-1 isolated yield, participant-specific recoveries, 12-crown-4 in entry 9, and CH2Br2 measurement basis. Dashes were not converted to zero.

unresolved: Table 1 omits solvent volumes, atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
All complex product connectivities and stereochemistry remain machine-unverified; SI association is unestablished.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left continuation of Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: The prose confirms entry 12 at 10 °C, 28% product, and 19% recovered 2a, and establishes the standard 1.5-equiv tBuOLi/aldehyde, THF, 50 °C, 1.5 h conditions. These statements enrich the existing row records rather than creating duplicate experiments.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 2 reaction header, rows 1–13, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Thirteen distinct aldehyde-scope rows were retained, including the separate gram-scale entry 2, tBuONa/1 h overrides for entries 9–13, exact THF volume for ordinary rows, and isolated yields. The gram-scale stoichiometric reversal stated in prose was preserved without forcing ordinary-row quantities onto it.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 reaction header, rows 1–7, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Seven allenoate-scope experiments were retained independently with 1 mmol scale, aldehyde/base equivalents, THF 6 mL, 50 °C/1.5 h, isolated yields, and the entry-1 82% product-purity NMR result with CH2Br2.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 2 and control-experiment prose
regions.finding: Four distinct controls were retained: NaOH gives cis-4ha and (E)-3ha with separate NMR/isolated yields; cis-4ha gives (E)-3ha; TBAF gives 5ha; and independently prepared 5ha gives (E)-3ha. The external preparation of 5ha is cited context, not a current experiment.

unresolved: Most scope rows omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
The gram-scale Table 2 row does not restate exact aldehyde/base/solvent absolute quantities.
No SI analytical or operational details were imported.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left continuation of 5ha control and Equation 1
regions.finding: The page confirms that 5ha formation was not observed under NaOH conditions, while cited-procedure 5ha gives (E)-3ha in 71%. Equation 1 is a separate axial-chirality control: (Sa)-2i (92% ee) gives racemic (E)-3ai in 77% yield (0% ee).

regions.region: page 3 left-center Scheme 3 and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: IM1–IM4/cis-IM3 are explicitly proposed intermediates. The sequence was classified as mechanism and no intermediate was treated as an isolated preparation.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 4 reaction header, rows 1–5, and footnote a
regions.finding: Five independent oxetane-scope experiments were retained with 1 mmol 2a, aldehyde/KOH equivalents, CuI 10 mol%, 1,4-dioxane 6 mL, open air, 50 °C, row times, and isolated yields. Unavailable Tables S1–S3 optimization details were not reconstructed.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Scheme 4 and adjacent prose
regions.finding: Four independent transformations of (E)-3aa were retained: Suzuki coupling to (E)-6aa, sequential C-allylation to (E)-7aa, C-propargylation to (E)-8aa, and two-stage selective ester reduction to (E)-9aa. Footnote reagents/loadings, staged temperatures/times, yields, no-O-alkylation observations, and chemoselectivity were structured.

unresolved: Tables S1–S3 are not associated and their optimization rows were not inferred.
Scheme 4 omits scales, most solvent volumes, workups, purifications, masses, and yield bases.
Oxetane structures remain label-only because stereochemical connectivity was not encoded confidently.

regions.region: page 4 left column and upper-right, references 1–7
regions.finding: Bibliography and prior-literature citations only. External papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article; no new current-paper arrow, table row, procedure, failure result, or outcome appears.

regions.region: page 4 right column footnote 8 crystal data and CCDC 945425
regions.finding: Crystal data support the E assignment of existing Table 3 entry 1 product (E)-3ab. Characterization and CCDC deposition are not another preparation and do not establish an SI association.

regions.region: page 4 right column footnote 9 and references 10–18
regions.finding: Footnote 9 attributes preparation of (Sa)-2i to a cited external paper, and the remaining content is bibliography. The external preparation was not turned into a current-paper experiment; Equation 1 remains the current reaction record.

unresolved: The CCDC deposition is characterization rather than SI and does not verify the machine SMILES.
No new reaction information is present on page 4; cited external procedures were not imported.
